content.text: In regions where traditional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms like Stripe fail, digital creators face significant hurdles in establishing effective online stores. You need a robust [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-2|The Full]] that not only supports automatic crypto payments but also ensures [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-how-bangladeshi-freelancers-accept-international-4|complete]] ownership of your data. This guide will explore how to use Supabase as the order database for your digital store, leveraging COREMERCH's Sovereign Blueprint, allowing you to deploy your store without relying on conventional payment systems.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

In the face of payment rejections and financial isolation, the architecture provided by COREMERCH ensures that creators retain full control over their commerce operations. Unlike conventional platforms that impose restrictions, this decentralized infrastructure allows you to deploy your digital store without intermediaries. By utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages alongside Supabase for order management, you establish a resilient environment tailored to your needs, specifically designed for creators in areas where traditional payment solutions are unavailable.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To successfully set up your digital store, gather the necessary tools: a GitHub account for hosting, access to Supabase for your order database, and NOWPayments for processing crypto transactions. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, whether they are eBooks, courses, or software. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint documentation, which outlines every step in detail. By preparing these elements in advance, you will streamline the deployment process and position yourself for a successful launch.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your payment layer using NOWPayments, which facilitates seamless transactions across 300+ cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee of 0.5%. Next, set up your Supabase instance as your order database, allowing you to securely store customer data and transaction records. Integrate file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure your products are automatically delivered upon payment confirmation. This pipeline not only enhances the customer experience but also ensures that you maintain full control over your operations without relying on traditional payment gateways.
Your infrastructure is fully owned; no third-party access after deployment.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After configuring your infrastructure, it’s time to test everything on the mainnet. Ensure that each component interacts seamlessly by conducting a series of test transactions. Monitor the order flow from payment initiation through to delivery confirmation. Once confirmed, promote your digital store across your networks, directing potential buyers to your store URL. This process allows you to validate your setup in real-world conditions, ensuring that your infrastructure can handle live transactions efficiently.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is operational, focus on scaling your offerings. Utilize the insights from your Supabase database to analyze customer behavior and product performance. This data will inform your marketing strategies and product development. Consider expanding your product range or optimizing existing offerings based on customer feedback. If you're looking for a more advanced setup, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced capabilities and support, deployed by COREMERCH in just 48 hours.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.

Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
